verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy axis for a real-time media and agent cloud platform, but the pack documents no retention policies, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle settings. The nearby evidence is only adjacent: a token grant permitting room deletion, recording/egress features, and the option to self-host or move off LiveKit Cloud. None of these is a product-level control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
